# spx_instance (Resource)

Manages an Instance on SPX.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu` (Number) The number of CPUs (max 32).
- `memory` (Number) The amount of memory in GB (max 64).
- `name` (String) The name of the instance.

### Optional

- `advanced` (Block, Optional) Advanced device/firmware overrides. Any unset value is inherited from the vm_type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--advanced))
- `az` (String) The availability zone of the instance. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `cloud_init` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--cloud_init))
- `container_disks` (List of String) IDs of the container disks (catalog entries, e.g. drivers) mounted on the instance. If not set, the recommended set is mounted at creation and the current mounts are kept on update; an empty list detaches all.
- `disks` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--disks))
- `labels` (List of String) The list of labels for the instance (keys must start with 'user.superphenix.net/').
- `network` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--network))
- `orga_id` (String) The organization ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `project_id` (String) The project ID. If not set, the provider value is used.
- `run_strategy` (String) The run strategy of the instance (e.g., Always, Manual, Halted).
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) The list of SSH key EIDs to add to the instance.
- `vm_type` (String) The type of VM. Default is 'linux'.

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) The CPU architecture of the instance.
- `id` (String) The ID of the instance.
- `ip_address` (String) The primary IP address of the instance.
- `ready` (Boolean) True if the instance is ready.

<a id="nestedblock--advanced"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced`

Optional:

- `efi` (Block, Optional) EFI bootloader (enabled = false forces BIOS). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--advanced--efi))
- `tpm` (Block, Optional) TPM device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--advanced--tpm))

<a id="nestedblock--advanced--efi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced.efi`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Boot with EFI (true) or BIOS (false).
- `persistent` (Boolean) Persist the EFI variables across reboots.
- `secure_boot` (Boolean) Enable Secure Boot.


<a id="nestedblock--advanced--tpm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `advanced.tpm`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable (true) or remove (false) the TPM device.
- `persistent` (Boolean) Persist the TPM state across reboots.



<a id="nestedblock--cloud_init"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init`

Optional:

- `bus` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `custom` (Boolean)
